name: Afghani x Colombian Gold (proto-Skunk)
summary: This unnamed cross, sometimes called proto-Skunk, paired [[afghani|Afghani]] with [[colombian-gold|Colombian Gold]] and was the first stage behind [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]]. It matured late, which led the Sacred Seeds collective to add [[acapulco-gold|Acapulco Gold]] and shorten flowering. Accounts differ on who made the original cross; one popular account credits a grower known as Jingles, before the seeds reached Santa Cruz.

sources.title: Sam the Skunkman: The Evolution of Hybrids
The Story Of Skunk #1
